lit.headline: Zlarior game plan for 2026-10-14: structure favours shorts (Trending down · high volatility); VIX band 30,495.31 / 31,087.69
lit.change_mind: A 1h close above 30,861.75 (the 1h protected high) turns the 1h structure up: shorts would then be against it; (history: with the 1h trend +0.25R a trade, n 224; against +0.12R, n 407: both pay); VIX above 25 would change the size of the move.

scenarios.if: Price sweeps the NY 09:30-10 high 30,660.75 by >= 0.5 ATR (to ~30,688) and a 5m candle closes back below ~30,633.5 (the CISD)
scenarios.then: Zlarior looks for a SHORT 5m CISD then the 1m CISD; stop ~80 pts (1 tick beyond the sweep extreme); target band 30,495.31 (1.7R) -> 6 micros at today's room = about +$1,647 / -$974. History: 332 Zlarior shorts like it won 53%, average +0.19R

scenarios.if: Price sweeps the equal lows 30,453 by >= 0.5 ATR (to ~30,425.75) and a 5m candle closes back above ~30,480.25 (the CISD)
scenarios.then: Zlarior looks for a LONG 5m CISD then the 1m CISD; stop ~80 pts (1 tick beyond the sweep extreme); target band 31,087.69 (7.6R) -> 3 micros at today's room = about +$3,639 / -$487. History: 163 Zlarior longs like it won 58%, average +0.24R

atlas.headline: ATLAS game plan: 2 members on watch (EMA off until its next window); Trending down · high volatility
atlas.change_mind: A 15m / 1h break against the members' side would put them on the other side. A 1h trend flip changes which members can fire.
